svg.desc: prisdvl@dev:~$ cat ~/motd Welcome to Prisd's terminal Java Backend / AI Systems · agents · RAG · distributed systems prisdvl@dev:~$ whoami prisdvl · github.com/Prisdvl prisdvl@dev:~$ date tz Asia/Shanghai uptime building agents & RAG backends prisdvl@dev:~$ cat ~/stack.bars Java ████████░░ 80% Spring Boot ████████░░ 80% MySQL ███████░░░ 70% Redis ███████░░░ 70% Spring Cloud ██████░░░░ 60% RabbitMQ ██████░░░░ 60% Docker ██████░░░░ 60% Spring AI ██████░░░░ 60% RAG / AI Agent██████░░░░ 60% TypeScript █████░░░░░ 50% React █████░░░░░ 50% Python ███░░░░░░░ 30% prisdvl@dev:~$ cat ~/card.yaml identity focus Spring AI · RAG · Agent · Distributed Systems runtime Spring Boot · Spring AI · FastAPI · Tauri · Django async Celery · message queues · tool-calling agents topics hybrid retrieval · RAG eval · production agents now agent platforms · retrieval eval · Tauri tooling status online · open to collab on agents / RAG prisdvl@dev:~$ cat ~/skills.md backend APIs · distributed services · Spring ecosystem ai RAG pipelines · agent loops · retrieval eval data OCR pipelines · async workers · MySQL client Vue · React · Tauri desktop prisdvl@dev:~$ head ~/highlights ▸ Spring AI knowledge base + tool-calling agent platform ▸ K-12 grading pipeline: OCR → queue · LLM scoring ▸ Rust/Tauri focus timer with liquid-glass UI
